review.title: Nhận xét bài viết trên lớp
paragraphs: Some people argued that children should be grow up and learn through trial and errors rather than depends on their parents to help them avoid mistakes. So their freedom to make mistakes should be encouraged and provide that errors do not involve serious danger for them.

Admittedly, some opponents of a trial and errors approach often emphasise. From the beginning, to today, technology have been developed, everything can learned from the pictures, without get hurt to learn of dangerous like knives, fire and electricity are unnecessary to get hurt and to understand how dangerous is it. Moreover, protect children was the parents duty, and the obvious they will shielded their child from dangerous things, they would like to forestall child from made mistakes, and just with that, they would feel like they have fulfilled the duty to protect their child. Not only prevent their child from danger, parents also pre-emptively help children to do everything right from the first time, this methods could give parents a peace of mind, when they have tried their best to grow up their child.

Moreover, those on the other side have their own valid reasoning. Parents have to go to work for the whole day for money and to improve family living conditions, so that they can not stay with their child for all of time, this not a negative for them, as some parents think this is a good way for children to explore the world, they have chances to experiment new things, and also when they learn some new things, made a mistake was a predictable, and from the mistake, they could easily gain some valuable lessons to provide them self to be better, give them a good stead at every stage of life. When they enter to the life, they have to be independent to solve their own problems without parents support, also they have to ready with all the challenges they have to face for the future.

Overall, it seems to me that allow children to learn from mistakes could be essential to get them ready for their life and also their future. But parents still have to have an influence with their kids and give them some guidance on important matters, from that, parents can prevent kids from some errors that may derail their future.

review.overall: Em có đủ bốn đoạn và đưa vào nhiều ý riêng về công nghệ, công việc của cha mẹ, bài học từ trải nghiệm. Nhưng Body 1 và Body 2 là các chuỗi câu rất dài, nhiều phần ghép không đúng hoặc không có căn cứ: “everything can learned from the pictures”, “the obvious they will shielded”, “made a mistake was a predictable”. Bài làm còn cẩu thả ở khâu dựng câu và tự soát; em cần tách câu, xác định chủ thể, rồi nối lại bằng lập luận thật.

paragraphs: Some people argue that children should grow up learning through trial and error, while others believe their parents should help them avoid mistakes. I think children should have the freedom to make mistakes, provided that those errors do not expose them to serious danger.

Admittedly, some opponents of a trial-and-error approach emphasize that many dangers are avoidable. Today, technology can help parents use pictures to explain the dangers of knives, fire and electricity without letting children get hurt. Protecting children from such risks is a parental duty, and preventing harmful mistakes helps parents fulfil it. Parents who pre-emptively help their children can have peace of mind when they know they have tried their best to protect and raise them.

However, those on the other side have their own valid reasoning. Parents have to work to earn money and improve family living conditions; therefore, they cannot stay with their children all the time. This is not necessarily negative for children: some parents see it as a good opportunity for them to explore the world, experiment with new things and sometimes make mistakes. From those mistakes, children can gain valuable lessons that will stand them in good stead later in life. When they enter later life, they need to solve problems independently and be ready for future challenges without constant parental support.

Overall, it seems to me that allowing children to learn from mistakes could be essential to prepare them for later life. However, parents should still have an influence on their children and give them guidance on important matters to prevent errors that may derail their future.

task.text:
WRITING TASK 1
You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
The graph below shows the three different kinds of emission sources (oil/coal/gas) of greenhouse gas in the UK.
Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
Write at least 150 words.

images.alt: Biểu đồ khí thải từ oil, coal và gas tại Anh, 1990–2010

paragraphs: The given[…] graph illustrates three different kinds of emission sources of green house gas in the UK from 1990 to 2010.

Overall, in 1990 coal record the most carbon emissions sources[…] by oil and coal, after 5 years, coal still was the highest number[…] and gas[…] the second place. In 2000 to 2010, gas takes the lead with the[…] followed by oil and coal.

Firstly, coal[…] when[…] highest emissions[…] 300 million tons, following with oil around 270 million tons and gas with around 220 million tons. Then 5 years later,[…] coal still a leader but have seen[…] with just around 280 million tons, but in 1995[…] a significant increase of gas which increase from 220 to 270 million tons[…] the second of emission sources, meanwhile oil level[…] around 240 million tons which are lowest point in 1995.

Regarding to the last century,[…] the significant increase of gas made it become a new leader of the chart, from 2000 to 2010, gas still to take a lead with 300, 310 and 320 million tons[…]. Oil and coal[…] with oil[…] from 260 million tons to 210 million tons[…], while coal[…] from 250 million tons to 190 million tons[…] which the lowest point of the whole chart.
review.overall: Em nhận ra đúng xu hướng chính: gas tăng và dẫn đầu từ năm 2000, còn coal giảm về cuối kỳ; em cũng nêu nhiều mốc số liệu phù hợp. Tuy nhiên, một số câu ghép quá dài, gọi nhầm lượng phát thải là số nguồn và dùng động từ chưa đúng. Chữ viết khó đọc, nhiều chỗ không rõ; em cần viết rõ hơn và gạch sửa dứt khoát để người đọc theo được toàn bộ bài.

criteria.label: Task Achievement
criteria.comment: Em có overview nêu gas vươn lên và coal giảm; các đoạn chi tiết dùng nhiều mốc 1990, 1995 và 2000–2010 với số liệu nhìn chung khớp biểu đồ. Tuy vậy, vài cách nêu đại lượng chưa chính xác và phần so sánh quan trọng ở mốc 2000 chưa thật nổi bật.

criteria.label: Coherence and Cohesion
criteria.comment: Bài có mở bài, tổng quan và hai phần số liệu theo thời gian nên mạch chính theo được. Trong các đoạn chi tiết, nhiều ý nối bằng dấu phẩy hoặc từ nối lặp, làm quan hệ giữa các mốc chưa luôn rõ.

criteria.label: Lexical Resource
criteria.comment: Em dùng được từ mô tả xu hướng như increase, lead và lowest, nhưng các cụm “emission sources”, “highest number”, “the last century” và “the second of emission sources” thiếu chính xác hoặc thiếu tự nhiên.

criteria.label: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.comment: Em thử viết câu có mệnh đề quan hệ và đối chiếu số liệu, nhưng các lỗi rõ như “coal record”, “which increase”, “gas still to take a lead” và “which the lowest point” cho thấy động từ và cấu trúc câu chưa ổn định.

annotations.explanation: Dùng “from ... to ...” hoặc “between ... and ...” khi nêu một khoảng thời gian.
annotations.replacement: From 2000 to 2010

annotations.quote: following with oil around 270 million tons and gas with around 220 million tons
annotations.title: Cách nối và nêu số liệu
annotations.explanation: Sau mệnh đề về coal, dùng “followed by” để xếp thứ tự; đặt “at” trước số liệu của từng loại.
annotations.replacement: followed by oil at around 270 million tons and gas at about 220 million tons

annotations.quote: which increase from 220 to 270 million tons
annotations.title: Thì quá khứ của xu hướng
annotations.explanation: Em mô tả sự thay đổi từ 1990 đến 1995, nên động từ trong mệnh đề quan hệ phải là “increased”.
annotations.replacement: which increased from about 220 to 270 million tons

annotations.quote: which are lowest point in 1995
annotations.title: So sánh ở một mốc
annotations.explanation: “Oil level” là số ít và em đang kể mốc quá khứ; thêm “the” trước dạng so sánh nhất.
annotations.replacement: which was the lowest figure in 1995

annotations.quote: Regarding to the last century
annotations.title: Nêu đúng giai đoạn
annotations.explanation: “Regarding” không đi với “to”; “the last century” cũng không chỉ rõ phần số liệu 2000–2010 mà em sắp trình bày.
annotations.replacement: From 2000 onwards

annotations.quote: gas still to take a lead
annotations.title: Hoàn chỉnh động từ
annotations.explanation: Sau chủ ngữ “gas” cần động từ chia thì; “still to take” chưa tạo thành vị ngữ của câu này.
annotations.replacement: gas continued to lead

annotations.quote: which the lowest point of the whole chart
annotations.title: Mệnh đề quan hệ thiếu động từ
annotations.explanation: Mệnh đề mở bằng “which” cần “was”; 190 triệu tấn là mức thấp nhất trong các cột được trình bày.
annotations.replacement: which was the lowest figure on the chart

paragraphs.text: The bar chart compares greenhouse gas emissions from gas, oil and coal in the UK at five points between 1990 and 2010. Figures are measured in million tons.

Overall, gas emissions rose throughout the period and became the largest of the three from 2000 onwards. Coal emissions declined steadily and finished as the smallest source. Oil fell overall, although it rose briefly between 1995 and 2000.

In 1990, coal produced about 310 million tons of emissions, followed by oil at around 270 million tons and gas at approximately 220 million tons. By 1995, coal had fallen to roughly 280 million tons, but it remained the largest source. Gas increased to about 270 million tons and overtook oil, which had dropped to around 240 million tons.

From 2000 onwards, gas led the three fuels, rising from approximately 300 million tons to 320 million tons in 2010. Oil stood at about 260 million tons in 2000 before falling to around 210 million tons at the end. Coal also decreased, from roughly 250 to 190 million tons over the same decade. Its final figure was the lowest on the chart.

review.title: Task 2 · History, science and technology

task.text:
WRITING TASK 2
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Some people say history is one of the most important school subjects. Other people think that, in today’s world, subjects like science and technology are more important than history. Discuss both these views and give your own opinion.
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.

paragraphs: Some people said that history was one of the most important subjects, when the other opinion say that subjects like Science and technology now have more effect to our life than history. With me, I think both subjects are have the same benefits.

First of all, the opinion say that history has power[…], cause it[…] especially for children or students, who still have a brain[…], history can bring to them the knowledge about their country in the past, because[…] the original of their country, also the[…] or their traditions.[…] history help the students to learn more about the world, make an example to, what teenagers[…] to get[…] the[…], and each of them[…] by history.

On the other hand, Science and technology have a[…] affect on students, nowadays,[…] or technology[…] or Artificial Intelligence, so that the technology become more popular with parents and students, cause it help them[…] who study it to get more information and broaden their knowledge on tech. Beside that, the technology companies always find new employees[…] and also students who study technology also help to gain a opportunity for job[…] field. With science, it also[…] for adult, and also[…] have a good[…] as students who learn it, Science has a[…] that make them[…] because Science it could help students have a deep knowledge of human, also give them creativity to reach[…] country-edge technology for research, and of course, Science has[…] of the[…] higher salary[…] and also have very many job opportunities.
In conclusion, history and science and tech are very good because[…] of students and still an important subjects. With my opinion, I think[…] and[…] subjects are necessary[…] students.
review.overall: Em đã bàn cả lợi ích của lịch sử và khoa học–công nghệ, đồng thời nêu quan điểm hai nhóm môn đều quan trọng. Ý về hiểu quá khứ và cơ hội nghề nghiệp phù hợp, nhưng cần một ví dụ cụ thể cho mỗi phía và câu ngắn hơn để mạch lập luận rõ. Chữ viết khó đọc, nhiều chỗ không rõ; em cần viết rõ từng từ và gạch sửa dứt khoát để người đọc đánh giá được toàn bộ ý của em.

criteria.label: Task Response
criteria.comment: Em nêu được cả hai quan điểm và ý kiến rằng lịch sử cùng khoa học–công nghệ đều có giá trị. Phần đọc được giải thích lịch sử giúp hiểu đất nước, còn khoa học–công nghệ mở rộng tri thức và cơ hội việc làm; các lý do vẫn cần ví dụ cụ thể và liên hệ chặt hơn với câu hỏi môn nào quan trọng hơn.

criteria.label: Coherence and Cohesion
criteria.comment: Bố cục mở bài, hai phía và kết luận có thể nhận ra, nhưng trong từng đoạn em gộp nhiều ý vào câu dài và lặp science/technology, students, also. Các quan hệ nguyên nhân và ví dụ vì vậy chưa được nối rõ.

criteria.label: Lexical Resource
criteria.comment: Bài có từ đúng chủ đề như traditions, Artificial Intelligence, employees và job opportunities, nhưng nhiều cụm thiếu tự nhiên hoặc chưa đúng nghĩa: “effect to our life”, “the original of their country”, “a opportunity”, “very many job opportunities”.

criteria.label: Grammatical Range and Accuracy
criteria.comment: Em thử dùng câu có mệnh đề phụ và cấu trúc chỉ nguyên nhân, nhưng các lỗi đọc rõ như “the other opinion say”, “subjects are have”, “history help” và “an important subjects” lặp lại. Câu quá dài cùng dấu phẩy làm một số quan hệ khó theo.

annotations.quote: when the other opinion say
annotations.title: Nối hai quan điểm
annotations.explanation: Ở đây hai quan điểm đối chiếu nhau nên dùng “while”; “others” chỉ những người giữ ý kiến còn lại. Vì vế trước dùng “said”, giữ cùng thì ở vế này.
annotations.replacement: while others said

annotations.quote: have more effect to our life
annotations.title: Giới từ sau effect
annotations.explanation: Dùng “effect on” và “our lives”; thêm “a greater” để so sánh tác động của hai nhóm môn.
annotations.replacement: have a greater effect on our lives

annotations.quote: both subjects are have the same benefits
annotations.title: Một vị ngữ và một lập trường rõ
annotations.explanation: “Are have” đặt hai động từ chính cạnh nhau. Phần thân bài nói hai nhóm môn có các lợi ích khác nhau, nên em có thể giữ ý cả hai đều quan trọng mà không gọi lợi ích của chúng là giống hệt nhau.
annotations.replacement: both subject areas have important but different benefits

annotations.quote: history can bring to them the knowledge about their country in the past
annotations.title: Diễn đạt kiến thức lịch sử
annotations.explanation: Dùng “give students knowledge of” hoặc “help students learn about”; “bring to them the knowledge” không tự nhiên.
annotations.replacement: history can give them knowledge of their country's past

annotations.quote: the original of their country
annotations.title: Nguồn gốc của đất nước
annotations.explanation: Khi nói nguồn gốc hoặc quá trình hình thành, dùng danh từ “origins” thay cho tính từ “original”.
annotations.replacement: the origins of their country

annotations.quote: history help the students
annotations.title: Chủ ngữ số ít
annotations.explanation: “History” là tên một môn học và là chủ ngữ số ít, nên động từ ở hiện tại là “helps”.
annotations.replacement: history helps students

annotations.quote: the technology become more popular
annotations.title: Động từ với technology
annotations.explanation: “Technology” ở nghĩa chung không cần “the”; nếu mô tả thay đổi đến hiện tại, dùng “has become”.
annotations.replacement: technology has become more popular

annotations.quote: cause it help them
annotations.title: Viết đầy đủ nguyên nhân
annotations.explanation: Trong văn viết học thuật, dùng “because”; chủ ngữ “it” cần động từ “helps”.
annotations.replacement: because it helps them

annotations.quote: Beside that
annotations.title: Từ nối bổ sung
annotations.explanation: Khi bổ sung một ý, dùng “Besides” hoặc “In addition”; “beside” chỉ vị trí ở bên cạnh.
annotations.replacement: In addition

annotations.quote: a opportunity
annotations.title: Mạo từ trước nguyên âm
annotations.explanation: “Opportunity” bắt đầu bằng âm nguyên âm nên đi với “an”.
annotations.replacement: an opportunity

annotations.quote: very many job opportunities
annotations.title: Diễn đạt số lượng cơ hội
annotations.explanation: “Very many” gượng trong văn học thuật; dùng “many” hoặc “a wide range of”.
annotations.replacement: many job opportunities

annotations.quote: science and tech
annotations.title: Không viết tắt trong bài học thuật
annotations.explanation: Viết đầy đủ “technology” trong bài luận; giữ cùng tên nhóm môn với phần mở bài.
annotations.replacement: science and technology

annotations.quote: an important subjects
annotations.title: Số nhiều sau subjects
annotations.explanation: “Subjects” là số nhiều nên bỏ “an”.
annotations.replacement: important subjects

annotations.quote: With my opinion
annotations.title: Nêu ý kiến của em
annotations.explanation: Cụm chuẩn để mở ý kiến cá nhân là “In my opinion”.
annotations.replacement: In my opinion

paragraphs.text: People disagree about the place of history in the school curriculum. Some regard it as a particularly important subject, whereas others place greater value on science and technology in modern life. In my opinion, both areas deserve attention because they offer different kinds of knowledge and opportunities to students.

History helps young people understand how their country developed and why its traditions matter. When students learn about past events, they can see how earlier generations made decisions that still affect society today. For example, a lesson about a struggle for independence can show what people sacrificed to protect their community. This knowledge can help students appreciate their country's culture rather than treat familiar customs as meaningless. Historical study can also teach them to compare accounts and evidence before accepting a claim. These benefits make history valuable even to students who will not work as historians.

Science and technology offer a different set of benefits. Science lessons encourage students to investigate problems, test explanations and use evidence. Technology classes help them understand digital tools and adapt to new ways of working. For instance, students who learn basic programming could later apply those skills in healthcare, engineering or research. As these fields develop, employers may seek people who can use technology confidently and solve practical problems. Studying these subjects can therefore broaden students' career options and help them contribute to their communities. This does not make historical knowledge unnecessary; it shows that the two areas serve different purposes.

In conclusion, history can strengthen students' understanding of the past, while science and technology can prepare them for future challenges. Because each group of subjects offers benefits that the other cannot fully replace, schools should give students a sound education in both.
